name: Tangie Hash
description:
Tangie Hash | Tangie Hash Effects

Tangie Hash is a premium cannabis hash concentrate crafted from the renowned Tangie strain, a sativa-dominant hybrid famous for its bold tangerine aroma and energizing effects. Loved for its vibrant citrus flavor and smooth potency, T Hash is ideal for users seeking daytime focus, creativity, and mood elevation.

Made from high-quality Tangie cannabis flowers, this hash delivers a terpene-rich experience that stands out among citrus hash strains and sativa hash concentrates.

As a sativa-dominant hash, T Hash is known for producing uplifting and mentally stimulating effects, including:

Euphoric and happy mood,

Increased focus and motivation,

Enhanced creativity and sociability,

Mild body relaxation without heaviness.

Because of this balance, it often appears in searches like Tangie hash effects, best sativa hash, and THC hash for energy.

Flavor & Aroma Profile

T Hash is instantly recognizable by its strong, sweet citrus scent. Its terpene profile offers: Fresh tangerine and orange peel notes, Sweet, fruity undertones, Light earthy and herbal finish
